responsibility: This build helper script generates gcc/config/m68k/m68k-tables.opt from the declarative device, ISA, and microarchitecture lists in m68k-devices.def, m68k-isas.def, and m68k-microarchs.def. It emits GCC option-table Enum and EnumValue entries for -mcpu=, -mtune=, and -march= by extracting names and enumeration constants with awk, so the driver and option parser can share a generated, synchronized list of accepted M68K CPU and tuning names.
